programme.title: Dorian Gray
programme.desc: Dorian, a young man of rare beauty, is shocked by a painter's stunning portrait of him. Knowing that sooner or later the harmony of his features will be faded by time, while the portrait will always remain the same, Dorian makes a wish: that only the portrait will grow old!

programme.title: Until Judge Do Us Part
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto and Mauro are four friends, all separated. Massimo is the freshest in separation and the judge has taken everything from him: the house, the daughter and forced him to pay a large monthly check to his wife. The three friends stand by him to hearten him and give him advice on coping with the separation and getting back to living a normal life, but surprises are just around the corner.

programme.desc: The multi-award-winning Italian film Lovers deals symmetrically with four stories involving the same five protagonists in different roles, locked in a spiral of betrayals, fierce revenge, twists and turns and a reflection on the importance of culture.
